{{Quote|Putting an end to a three-month scandal in the halls of higher learning on Alderaan, Provost Dalus Othona formally censured and suspended Dean Halcor Raystel.|A HoloNet News report on the suspension of the Dean|<ref name="HNN" />}}
'''Dean''' was a title and a position of authority within educational establishments. The [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]],<ref name="HNN" /> located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] on<ref name="Aldera">{{CSWECite|I|19|Aldera}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> had a dean who was subordinate to the position of [[Provost/Legends|Provost]]. Provosts could censure and suspend a dean when the need arose. The position of dean required appointed individuals to hold pedigree credentials.<ref name="HNN" />

The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Halcor Raystel]] lacked such credentials when appointed as dean, which lead to accusations of nepotism.<ref name="HNN" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">According to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|life/13314_2.html|Dean of Aldera Suspended}}, it was reported on [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:3:14 that [[Halcor Raystel]] had recently been dismissed as dean. That date corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Raystel was censured and suspended by Provost [[Dalus Othona]] after a three-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] scandal following Raystel's propositioning of students and abuse of the [[Spice/Legends|substance]] [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]]. On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:3:14, the matter was reported upon by an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN" />

The dean of the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]], spread throughout the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]]<ref name="UoC" /> on the planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], held the distinct title of [[Cadaeda]].<ref name="UoC" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the [[Leadership School]] on the planet [[Andara]] had an assistant dean named [[Aeradin]], a nonhuman who was also a professor at the school.<ref name="Fear">''[[Jedi Quest: The School of Fear]]''</ref>

A [[JV-Z1/D butler droid]] named [[ZZ-4Z]], or ZeeZee, was placed in the service of the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Spacers Academy's]] Dean. He was willed to the subsequent 17 deans and amassed a repository of embarrassing trivia on the academics whilst in their service. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] provided the [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] [[Mako Spince]] with the codes to the university's physics lab. Spince used his newfound access to steal [[antimatter]] and, as a prank, destroyed the Academy's mascot [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. Dean [[Horace Wyrmyr]] ordered the ZeeZee to be destroyed for the droid's part in the incident. Spince recovered ZZ-4Z before Wyrmyr's orders could be completed, and eventually lost the droid to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="ZZ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dean was first mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #47'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[March 14]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN47 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archivedate=20200305125429}}</ref> In real life, a [[Wikipedia:Dean (education)|dean]] is the head of a division, faculty, college, or school of a university.<ref name="Dict">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/dean|text=Dean Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20220103131507}}</ref>
